cohort: The cohort consisted of 781 pregnancies exposed to SLE and 11,271 pregnancies from the general population, identified through Swedish National Register data between 2001 and 2013.
finding: Preterm delivery is significantly more common in SLE pregnancies compared to the general population, with a considerable proportion of this risk mediated through preeclampsia.
gest_age: <37 weeks (for preterm delivery), <32 weeks (for extremely preterm), 32 to <37 weeks (for later preterm)
